# Wrenchli

> Wrenchli is a free AI-powered vehicle symptom assessment platform serving Michigan and Ohio, providing consumers with likely causes, urgency levels, and fair cost ranges before they visit a repair shop.

Wrenchli helps vehicle owners understand what is likely wrong with their car before visiting a repair shop. Consumers describe their vehicle's symptoms, and Wrenchli's AI-powered assessment returns a structured report including possible causes with probability scores, urgency levels (immediate, soon, schedule, monitor), estimated cost ranges, and questions to ask a mechanic.

Wrenchli is operated by Wrenchli, Inc., a Delaware corporation founded by Gerrod Parchmon. The platform is currently in pilot phase in Michigan and Ohio, with partner independent repair shops in Metro Detroit.

Wrenchli is not a licensed mechanic and does not provide professional diagnostic services. All assessments are informational symptom analyses intended to help consumers have more informed conversations with qualified automotive technicians.

## Core pages

- [Vehicle symptom assessment](https://wrenchli.net): Free AI-powered assessment of vehicle symptoms. No account required. Takes approximately 60 seconds. Returns likely causes, urgency, cost range, and shop questions.
- [About Wrenchli](https://wrenchli.net/about): Company background, founder, mission, and the information asymmetry problem Wrenchli addresses.
- [For repair shops](https://wrenchli.net/for-shops): Information for independent automotive repair shops interested in the 90-day free partner pilot program.
- [Garage](https://wrenchli.net/garage): Authenticated vehicle garage with saved assessments, recall alerts, and vehicle history. Free tier allows 2 vehicles. Pro tier ($2.99/month) allows unlimited vehicles.

## Content library

- [Blog](https://wrenchli.net/blog): Educational articles covering vehicle symptoms, OBD-II diagnostic trouble codes, and DIY maintenance guides.
- [Check engine light: What P0420 means](https://wrenchli.net/blog/check-engine-light-p0420): Complete guide to the P0420 diagnostic trouble code, common causes, and repair cost ranges.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://wrenchli.net/privacy): How Wrenchli handles consumer data, vehicle information, and VIN privacy. VIN data is optional, stored securely, never sold, and deletable at any time.
- [Warranty guide](https://wrenchli.net/warranty-guide): Manufacturer warranty reference for common vehicle makes and model years.

## Canonical definitions

Wrenchli: A free AI-powered vehicle symptom assessment platform operating in Michigan and Ohio, founded in 2025, incorporated as Wrenchli, Inc.

Symptom assessment: Wrenchli's core service. An AI-driven analysis of vehicle symptoms that returns likely causes with probability scores, urgency levels, and cost ranges. Distinct from professional diagnosis, which requires a qualified automotive technician with physical access to the vehicle.

Urgency levels: Wrenchli classifies repair urgency as immediate (safety risk, do not drive), soon (address within 1 to 2 weeks), schedule (plan a shop visit), or monitor (watch for changes).

Verified Score: Wrenchli's shop rating methodology combining symptom-to-repair match rate, cost fairness percentile against local market data, and consumer satisfaction ratings. The methodology is established. Published accuracy data becomes available once outcome report volume reaches statistical significance.

Partner shop: An independent automotive repair shop participating in Wrenchli's pilot program. Partner shops receive pre-assessed customers with vehicle details, likely causes, and estimated cost ranges before the customer arrives.

## Geographic coverage

Active: Michigan (primary focus: Metro Detroit — Wayne, Oakland, Macomb counties). Active pilot phase.

Active: Ohio. Active pilot phase.

The symptom assessment service itself is available to any United States vehicle owner. Partner shop matching is currently limited to Michigan and Ohio.
